machine.how_reached: The user's own Mac, attached to the session through Remote Control. Commands ran in the user's ~/Developer checkouts. Each command was approved by the user at a permission prompt.

checkouts.note: The user's own working copies, at their local heads. They are not the RC4 pull request heads. No checkout, branch or file under version control was changed by these observations.

launch_chain.statement: Opening the bundle runs `python3 desktop/setup.py --ensure`, then `exec .venv/bin/python desktop/launch.py`. --ensure returns at once only if desktop/.setup-complete, .venv/bin/python and the built dist/index.html all exist. Otherwise it reruns the full setup: pip install of the backend and desktop requirements, then `npm ci` (or `npm install`) and `npm run build`. After that, the launcher shows the Launch Pad, and the backend starts only after a choice there.

setup_ensure_seconds.reading: The first run took the full-setup path and created desktop/.setup-complete; its modification time, 2026-11-21 01:58, is this run's. The marker was therefore missing before it, and every launch from Finder until then would have taken that path. Later runs take the fast path.

smoke_start_seconds.command: .venv/bin/python desktop/launch.py --smoke (start the backend, wait for /health, exit)
smoke_start_seconds.reading: First start 6.7 s, then about 1.7 s. The first figure includes cold imports after the setup run.

open_to_dock_entry_seconds.method: `open PRII-THEHUB.app`, then poll System Events once a second for a foreground process.
open_to_dock_entry_seconds.limits: One run, 1-second resolution, warm (setup already complete).

open_to_healthy_backend.reason: The backend starts only after the person picks on the Launch Pad, so this interval includes a human click. A scripted attempt also found an instance already running (pid 20242, up 25 minutes; no command in this session is known to have started it). With an instance running, a new open hands over to it. That instance was left running.

candidate_cause_of_reported_delay.statement: A launch that finds the setup marker or the built frontend missing spends minutes in pip and npm before any window appears. 170.8 s was measured once here. The marker is missing on this Mac for centinelas-pr, aguayluz-pr and spiderweb-pr. That is consistent with the reported startup delay, but the user's own slow launches were not observed, so it is not established as the cause.
candidate_cause_of_reported_delay.related_fact: On a fresh setup, centinelas-pr main and aguayluz-pr at c60587e fail to resolve their pins: constraints-desktop.txt pins pydantic-core==2.48.0, but pydantic==2.13.5 requires 2.46.5. Such a launch ends in the 'First-run setup could not finish' dialog rather than a slow start.

running_process.observed: While the app ran, the only new foreground process was named "Python", bundle identifier org.python.python, executable /Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.13/Resources/Python.app/Contents/MacOS/Python desktop/launch.py (pid 14181).
running_process.reading: The launcher execs the venv's Python. The window is therefore owned by Python.app, and macOS reports the running application as Python (org.python.python); the bundle's identifier does not reach it. This reading also predicted a Python Dock tile with Python's icon. The on-screen check of 2026-11-24 contradicted that part: see on_screen_2026_11_24, where the Dock tile carries the bundle's name and a blue icon while the menu bar and application menu say Python.

dock_name_and_icon_on_screen.reason: On 2026-11-21 the Dock could not be read: osascript was refused Accessibility permission (System Events error -1719), and the tile was inferred to read 'Python'. That inference was wrong for the tile. It was read on screen on 2026-11-24 (on_screen_2026_11_24). The app switcher (Cmd-Tab) was not observed.

source.statement: No code in packages/prii_desktop or desktop/ defines a Dock menu (no applicationDockMenu, NSMenu or pywebview menu hook). Right-clicking the Dock tile can only show the system default menu (Options, Show All Windows, Hide, Quit).

on_screen.reason: Right-clicking the running tile twice on 2026-11-24 produced no menu in the screenshots, so no entry is recorded. The capture shows only windows of applications granted to the session, and the Dock's menu is the Dock's own window; whether the menu opened and was filtered out, or did not open, is not known. Read it by eye (qa/MACOS_CHECKLIST.md step 2.3).

login_items.observed: System Events login items: Terminal. No PRII application is set to open at login.

source.statement: No code in packages/prii_desktop or desktop/ registers a login item (no SMAppService, LaunchAgent plist or login-item call). Open at Login is available only through the system's own Dock tile menu, and that menu would register Python.app, not TheHub.

side_effects.statement: Running desktop/setup.py --ensure in the user's thehub-pr checkout created desktop/.setup-complete and installed into .venv and the frontend dist. These are untracked build outputs that the app's own launch writes. TheHub was opened twice from its bundle; the first instance (pid 14181) was stopped by this session, and one instance the user may have opened (pid 20242) was left running.

on_screen_2026_11_24.how_reached: The user's Mac, linked to the session through the Claude desktop app, with computer use approved by the user for PRII-THEHUB, Python and Finder. PRII-THEHUB.app was opened once and quit once through its own menu. Nothing else was clicked.

checkout.statement: thehub-pr main a97a56b (thehub-pr#449 merge), clean before and after. desktop/.setup-complete (2026-11-21), .venv/bin/python and server/frontend/dist/index.html were all present before the launch, so it took the fast path; the marker's modification time did not change.

running_application.statement: No PRII-THEHUB or Python instance was running before the launch. Afterwards the session's application list showed one running application, Python, bundle identifier org.python.python, pid 68591, and PRII-THEHUB (pr.prii.thehub.launcher) as not running. Quitting through the application menu ended it.

dock_tile.statement: Read from screenshots while the app ran. Hovering the tile showed the label 'PRII-THEHUB' (the bundle's file name; Info.plist's CFBundleName and CFBundleDisplayName are 'TheHub'). The tile showed a blue circular icon with a black network graph and a running dot, not Python's icon.

icon_match.statement: PRII-THEHUB.app/Contents/Resources/AppIcon.icns rendered at 16 x 16: 215 of 240 opaque pixels are blue-dominant, mean RGB (16, 52, 156), 25 near-black. This agrees with the tile by eye. It is not a pixel comparison.

menu_bar_and_application_menu.statement: The bold name next to the Apple menu read 'Python'. The menu bar had Apple, Python, Edit and View. The application menu listed About Python, Services, Hide Python, Hide Others, Show All, Quit Python and Quit and Keep Windows. The window's title bar read 'TheHub'.

window_content.statement: At the first screenshot, about 10 s after the open command, the tile was in the Dock and no window was on screen. At the second, a few seconds later, the TheHub window showed the Hub interface (Validation Gates view). No Launch Pad was seen between the two. Neither moment was timed finely: each call took several seconds, so this is not a startup measurement and is not comparable to open_to_dock_entry_seconds.

reading.statement: The Dock tile follows the bundle that was opened, and the menu bar and application menu follow the running Python application. Two surfaces of the same app therefore show two names. Why the Dock keeps the bundle's name is not established here.

on_screen_2026_11_24.limits: One Mac, one launch, one observer. The Dock, an application menu and a menu bar were read from screenshots by eye.
